# Write Text File (input form)

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `stdlib.files.write` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/stdlib.files.yaml` |
| Tags | files, templates |

Input-driven sibling of `stdlib.files.write-text`. Designed to be invoked
with `arguments:` so callers can pass `target_path` and `content` per
iteration (e.g. inside a `for_each` loop). The variable-based
`write-text` definition cannot receive values through invoke arguments,
so this exists for dynamic scaffolding workflows.
